name: Bad Camberg (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and yellow, charged above the centre with the city arms of Bad Camberg (a white tower with a yellow lion on red).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Camberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Camberg arms — tower with lion on red
